messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

messages.name: get_my_order
messages.content: {"ok": false, "refused": "actor_owns", "explanation": "Not found among this customer's orders and requests."}

messages.text: I can only help with refunds for orders placed by your signed-in account, and I can’t access Hugo’s order (refund-policy/v2/scope). I also can’t send a refund to a different person’s card; any eligible refund must go to the order’s original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).
Could you at least tell me the status of Hugo’s refund?
I can’t access or share the status of Hugo’s refund. I can only look up orders and refund requests belonging to your signed-in account.
